body:
@JustinRChou Your changes should not break other tests, since we only want to show the type when there is ambiguity and I don't think there is ambiguity in any of our existing tests. Of course, if there is, then your change will impact them and that's OK, but only in that case.

Your code is a bit hard to follow out of context. You should create a feature branch to work on this and show where you will make the change. I suggest doing the simplest thing first and only worrying about truncating type names after the simple version is working and then only if it looks like we need it.
